propositions: BindingStore embeds multiple lifecycle concerns (identity transitions, pending/confirmed state, numeric-ID re-key, comment identity, tombstones, retirement) that should be extracted into a private policy owner in binding_lifecycle.py while preserving the public facade signatures

Production code reaches through shallow all_bindings() and mutates inner dictionaries; a narrow facade operation (note_rich_emit) must become the supported mutation seam for rich-text emission without changing all_bindings() copy depth

The lifecycle policy must maintain at-most-one identity invariant by targeted single-key reverse pops, handle three confirmed 404s triggering retirement, immutable numeric-ID re-keying instead of retiring, and preserve append-only comment ID semantics for legacy entries

Corrupt forward/reverse combinations, tombstoned issues, and missing bindings must retain current fail-open or fail-closed boundaries without behavior changes to corruption disposition, stored schema, or identity markers

The extracted policy must operate on the same original dictionaries through typed views with unknown/legacy fields remaining present and writable only through named policy operations, while the facade retains authoritative coordination
